source_id.description: Identifier of the source document/record, e.g. 'invoice_INV-001.pdf'.
source_id.title: Source Id

source_type.description: What kind of document source_id is, e.g. Invoice, Contract, ProofOfPayment.

extraction_method.description: How the value was obtained, e.g. 'tokenizer', 'manual_entry', 'ocr'.
extraction_method.title: Extraction Method

confidence.description: Extraction confidence in [0, 1]. Required — never defaulted.
confidence.title: Confidence

timestamp.description: When this evidence was captured/asserted. Defaults to now() if not supplied by the caller — this is a system-generated capture time, not an inferred business value, so it does not violate Rule 4 ('never infer missing values') to default it.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

source_record.description: Optional finer-grained locator within the source, e.g. 'paragraph_12', 'row_4'. Not part of the v2 spec's required fields; kept as an additive, optional extension.
source_record.title: Source Record
